svg.aria-label: Left, one password: your password, never written to disk, goes through Argon2id at 19 MiB, 2 passes and 1 lane, then XChaCha20-Poly1305 seals one JSON map of secrets into vault.db, holding nsec keys, Marmot secrets and the cache key. A wrong password fails the tag check, and there is no recovery. Right, separate processes: wn-image, wn-pdf, wn-archive, wn-mesh, wn-fbx, wn-math and wn-nes parse untrusted files outside the app, with a 1 GiB memory cap and no in-process fallback. Video is the exception: mpv stays in-process.

g.text: Every secret lives in one file
